methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
the objective is to
analyse how important and topical the development of
performance measurement is, in comparison to other
development issues

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Qualitative grounded-theory interview study of the organisational development priority and R&D needs of energy performance measurement across six companies in three sectors; energy performance indicators (e.g. uncorrected specific energy consumption) are discussed only as current management practice, and no specific EnPI/EnB model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach).
stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: paper critiques current energy performance measurement (uncorrected monthly/annual specific energy consumption) and urges explanatory/modelled indicators, but identifies no specific EnPI/EnB model. Judged ineligible under the v2.3 identify-and-characterise bar; flag for human review. Listed sectors (pulp & paper, basic metals, petrochemicals) are only multi-sector interview settings, so level_3b=false.
